FORM 10-Q QUARTERLY REPORT

Apple Inc.

For the quarterly period ended June 29, 2024

PART I — FINANCIAL INFORMATION

Item 1. Financial Statements

Condensed consolidated financial statements (unaudited) for the three and nine months ended June 29, 2024. Total net sales for the third quarter were $85.78 billion, up 5% from the year-ago quarter. Operating income rose to $25.35 billion.

Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Net sales increased during the third quarter of fiscal 2024 driven by sequential acceleration in iPhone revenue and robust Mac performance driven by M3 silicon upgrades. Greater China net sales stabilized, while Services established a new all-time quarterly revenue record of $24.21 billion. Gross margin expanded to 46.3% compared to 44.5% in the prior year quarter.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

There have been no material changes in the Company's market risk exposures since fiscal year-end 2023.

PART II — OTHER INFORMATION

Item 1A. Risk Factors

There have been no material changes from the risk factors previously disclosed in the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023. Regulatory scrutiny under the European Union Digital Markets Act continues to require architectural changes to iOS, Safari, and the App Store that may affect developer commission rates and user monetization.

Item 2. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds

The Company repurchased $26.0 billion of its common stock during the quarter.
